scope: Stage-2 authority, exact pinned tree, README and both contact-case source directories inspected statically. Prepared MAT inputs were identified but not loaded; TensorFlow models, training and visualizations were not executed.

unresolved_findings.finding: No repository license defines reuse terms.
No formal dependency manifest or installation command is provided despite README version declarations.
TensorFlow and NumPy seeds are uncontrolled; the compression case reports no seed and the ironing case sets only Python's random seed.
Coord.mat schemas, provenance and sample counts are not documented beyond the keys consumed by source.
No pretrained weights, reference output files, tests or quantitative acceptance thresholds are bundled.
The repository self-cites DOI 10.1016/j.cma.2025.117787, but no Atlas relationship is established for CR000175.
Prepared MAT inputs and numerical training behavior remain unvalidated within the static-only boundary.

notes: Two case directories are represented as two experiments.
